text.EN: It's down... but there are more.
text.TL: Patay na... pero may iba pa.

text.EN: You got it... God, look around us.
text.TL: Nakuha mo... Diyos ko, tingnan mo ang paligid.

text.EN: Dead... but I hear more shuffling.
text.TL: Patay na... pero may naririnig pa akong kaluskos.

text.EN: That one's down... don't let others flank.
text.TL: Bagsak na ang isang 'yon... huwag hayaang may pumaligid.

text.EN: It's over for that one... but we're not safe.
text.TL: Tapos na ang isa... pero hindi pa tayo ligtas.

text.EN: You killed it... please tell me that's the last one.
text.TL: Napatay mo... pakiusap sabihin mong huli na 'yan.

text.EN: One is down... but more could come.
text.TL: Isang bagsak... pero baka may dumating pa.

text.EN: Good, it's dead... just watch the darkness.
text.TL: Mabuti at patay na... mag-ingat lang sa dilim.

text.EN: Down... but my heart won't stop racing.
text.TL: Bagsak... pero ayaw humupa ng kaba ko.

text.EN: You stopped it... but we have to keep checking.
text.TL: Napigilan mo... pero kailangan nating patuloy na magmasid.
